summary: Closed another repo-side CI/bootstrap gap by fixing the SvelteKit preview artifact mismatch directly in the build pipeline. This iteration added `scripts/fix-sveltekit-preview-manifest.mjs`, which creates `.svelte-kit/output/server/manifest.js` as a compatibility shim when the build only emits `manifest-full.js`, added regression coverage in `tests/scripts/fix-sveltekit-preview-manifest.test.mjs`, and updated the `build` script in `package.json` to run that shim automatically after `vite build`. I also tightened the validator slice further: `scripts/validate-service-e2e-bootstrap.mjs` now matches the actual CI browser contract instead of incorrectly requiring `tests/e2e/service-details-visual.spec.ts`, and `.gitlab-ci.yml` now runs both node-based script tests inside `service-quote-gates`. Focused verification is green for `node --test tests/scripts/validate-service-e2e-bootstrap.test.mjs tests/scripts/fix-sveltekit-preview-manifest.test.mjs`, the shim creates the expected `manifest.js`, and the CI-shaped bootstrap validator now passes locally. After that fix, `npm run preview` advanced past the old manifest error and exposed the next concrete startup blocker: the current local build artifacts are still incomplete because `.svelte-kit/output/client` is missing, so preview/Playwright cannot start yet. I started a fresh `npm run build` rerun to drive the client/prerender stages, but it had not completed by the end of this iteration, so browser evidence remains open.
remaining_work: Finish a clean local/CI-shaped build that produces the full preview output contract, not just `.svelte-kit/output/server`, including `.svelte-kit/output/client` and any required prerendered output alongside `build/`.

Rerun the remaining Chromium and Mobile Safari `service-quotes-*`, `service-ux-hardening*`, `service-instant-buy*`, `homepage-featured-services*`, and `tasks-services-regression-*` suites once the preview artifact contract is fully satisfied.
Run the Chromium visual slice (`service-quotes-visual*`, `homepage-featured-services-visual*`) after the preview output is complete and preview startup is stable.
Finish the remaining `TEST-G3` / `TEST-G4` evidence pass and address any browser-level failures that surface once the full preview output contract is available.
